===[[Western North Region]]===
[[File:Districts_of_the_Western_North_Region_(2019).png|thumb|Western North Region]]
The Western North Region of Ghana was created by a referendum in December 2018. It was part of the then [[Western Region, Ghana|Western Region]] of Ghana. It contains 9 districts, 3 municipal and 6 ordinary districts. These are:
